outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the cabinet and aligns with the upper drawer handle (frames 40–91, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward (frames 120–160, image and left_ego_image). The extended drawer and exposed interior are visible at frames 160–183 in image and left_ego_image; wrist_image shows the gripper releasing and withdrawing from the handle at frames 165–183. The drawer remains open, with no visible failed acquisition, harmful collision, or disturbance of the tabletop objects.
